## Pull request overview

Fixes a console bug where editing/saving an app via the AppCreationWizard would persist an incomplete `AppSchema`, dropping metadata (`icon`, `label`, `branding`) needed for sidebar/app-switcher display.

**Changes:**
- Extend `AppSchema` and update `wizardDraftToAppSchema()` to include `label`, `icon`, and `branding`.
- Update `EditAppPage` to merge wizard output over the original app config before saving, preserving non-wizard fields (e.g. `active`, `actions`, `areas`).
- Add/adjust unit + integration tests to cover round-tripping and merge preservation; update roadmap test counts.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/app.ts | Adds `label`/`icon`/`branding`/`active` to `AppSchema` and maps wizard draft fields into the schema. |
| packages/types/src/__tests__/app-creation-types.test.ts | Adds assertions and edge cases for `icon`/`label`/`branding` mapping. |
| apps/console/src/pages/EditAppPage.tsx | Saves merged schema to avoid dropping app fields not managed by the wizard. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/app-creation-integration.test.tsx | Updates wizard mock output and adds an integration test ensuring merge preserves `active`. |
| ROADMAP.md | Updates documented test counts and notes about field preservation behavior. |
</details>

The TypeScript `AppSchema` now includes `label`, `icon`, `branding`, and `active`, but the corresponding Zod validator (`packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts` → `AppSchema`) does not include these fields. Because Zod object schemas strip unknown keys by default, any code that validates/parses an AppSchema via Zod could silently drop these new fields again. Please update the Zod `AppSchema` to accept these properties (and ideally add a small Zod test case covering them) to keep runtime validation in sync with the TS interface.
